html:
This past Sunday, August 11, 2024, we had the incredible opportunity to be part of Boating & Fishing Day at loanDepot Park, where the Miami Marlins took on the San Diego Padres. It was a day filled with excitement, showcasing the latest in boating technology and, of course, an unforgettable baseball game.

The event kicked off at 12 PM in the West Plaza, where various boating brands and companies, including ours, displayed their newest models and services. Whether you’re an experienced boater or simply curious about the latest in marine technology, there was something for everyone to enjoy. Our NHD boat, in particular, garnered a lot of attention, and we were thrilled to connect with so many boating enthusiasts.

As the event transitioned from the plaza to the ballpark, the excitement continued with an intense game between the Marlins and the Padres. The Marlins clinched a thrilling victory, winning 7-6, with two impressive home runs that had the crowd on their feet. It was a fantastic game that perfectly complemented the energy of Boating & Fishing Day.

We want to extend a heartfelt thank you to everyone who stopped by our display to check out the new NHD boat we had on show. Your enthusiasm and support made the day even more special. We also want to express our gratitude to the Miami Marlins for inviting us to be part of this amazing event. We can’t wait for the upcoming events and to see you all again soon!

Here’s to more great times on the water and more Marlins victories!
